quest.title: Go, Fietena, Go!
quest.description: Now's the time to run for your dreams, give it everything you've got!
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Don't blame yourself, Minnie. It's not your fault.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Yigang
dialogues.text: You did great, Minnie... *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Oh, Yigang... Don't force yourself to speak if you're not up to it. Honestly, I'm amazed you even made it here to watch.

choices.text: How did the end of the race go?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, uh...

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: It's okay, I'll explain. I'm really sorry, Honorary Knight, but by the time I got that wounded guy to the finish line, all the other teams had finished the race.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: The staff have taken him to get checked out, so I think he'll be okay. But... we didn't get the results we wanted. I'm sorry.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: You guys were leading the whole way, and I went and let the team down...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Oh, Minnie...

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: When I first saw that guy in trouble, I hesitated for a moment.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Everyone's worked so hard to get here. If I hadn't gone back to help him, we would've actually gotten a decent ranking...

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Amber and the emergency staff were nearby, and you guys weren't far away either. It's not like he would have been in life-threatening danger if I'd carried on...

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: But I just couldn't tear myself away.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: It's okay, Minnie. We understand.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: How could any of us turn a blind eye to a person in need?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: "Wherever the Soulblazer treads, help is always at hand."

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: ...Wait, where's that line from?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: My... brain? Just came up with it on the spot. Hehe...

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: ...Thanks, Captain.

response.speaker: Sherilyn
response.text: Minnie!

response.speaker: Sherilyn
response.text: Thank goodness you're okay. I was so worried.

response.speaker: Moritz
response.text: Minnie, you could've put your life at risk...

response.speaker: Sherilyn
response.text: Please, don't ever scare us like that again.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: I'm sorry...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: A minor incident ended up dashing your hopes of victory. It sucks... but that's life sometimes: You bust a gut and still end up with nothing to show for it.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: But nothing is wasted. Everyone had fun along the way, and seeds planted today may still bear fruit tomorrow.\nMinnie still looks a little frustrated, but she'll get through it.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Minnie, are you alright? Are you hurt at all?

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Oh, hi ref. No, I'm not hurt. I'm all good.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: ...It's you...

response.speaker: Kenzou
response.text: Hello. I'm Kenzou, from team Lightning Strike. Because of your help, I escaped with no major injuries. I can't thank you enough.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Team Lightning Strike has had a discussion with the organizing committee.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Minnie's actions in helping her fellow contestant are commendable. The organizing committee are all in agreement that were it not for this incident, team Soulblazers would have ranked much higher in the race.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: As things stand, team Soulblazers did not rank highly enough to receive medals. However, we believe that you still deserve recognition for your performance.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Therefore, in addition to the medals for winners and runners-up, the organizing committee has decided to issue a special honorary medal to your team, recognizing your commitment to putting lives first.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Thank you, Mr. Draff. Mom, Dad... I know what you're gonna say. A deal's a deal, I won't fight it...

response.speaker: Moritz
response.text: Very well. Then, we'll stick to what we all agreed. From now on, Minnie...

response.speaker: Moritz
response.text: ...As long as you promise to be careful, you are free to go traveling abroad.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: ...What? But Dad, I thought...

response.speaker: Moritz
response.text: You achieved what you set out to do — you got ranked in the competition. Maybe it wasn't the ranking you hoped for, but it's enough for me.

response.speaker: Sherilyn
response.text: Hehe, and for me. Look, you even have a medal to prove it.

response.speaker: Moritz
response.text: You know, maybe we should turn this into a family vacation. Yes... Let's all go and visit Yae Publishing House together.

response.speaker: Moritz
response.text: After hearing so much about your favorite comic books, I'd love to find out if they have anything suitable for older folks like me and your mother.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Amazing! Hey, Minnie, this is a great start!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: You have no idea how happy this makes me...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: This is a moment to remember. I think it calls for a photograph!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Good call. Alright, group photo!

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Let's pose like Fietena and Mavuika! From volume 2, where they go into battle together for the first time.

talks.objective: Head to the cross-country race arena

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The cross country contest is about to begin. So many people have shown up... How's everyone doing? Feeling ready?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Towels, hot soup, warm blankets... Yeah, I think I'm all set.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Captain is taking the team through a warm-up as planned.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Once the race starts, I'll go wait at the finish line to hand out water and blankets to the contestants.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: I got here a little late 'cause I was coming from home. Are they still warming up? The race is gonna start any minute...

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Yeah, I wonder what's taking them so long...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it's not like Varesa and Xilonen to be behind schedule... Okay, we'll go check on them.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Thanks, guys.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, they've finally emerged from the tent.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guys, what's wrong? You all look so serious...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: It's Yigang. He's come down with a fever.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: *sigh*... I wish I'd acted sooner... I've been checking in with him constantly since he started sneezing, and he said he was fine, but still. I should've known better.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: He probably hoped he could tough it out until the end of the competition. But now it's broken into a full-blown fever. He doesn't even have the energy to get out of bed.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: We've been in touch with the organizing committee, and they're making sure he stays warm and takes his medication. They actually sent a medic to look after him, so he's in good hands.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's good... But what about the race? You're one team member short, and it's about to kick off any minute...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yeah... What're we gonna do?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: This race is a huge deal for all of us. Minnie's parents are already waiting at the finish line... Our only hope now is...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: That was our first thought too. You've trained with us, so you know the course. Plus, you have a good level of fitness and plenty of outdoor experience.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: I don't feel great about roping you in at the last minute, though. There's nothing worse than someone dumping an urgent job on you when you least expect it, and making you feel like you can't turn it down.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: We'd love to have you on the team — but only if you're willing.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #Hehe... Tumaini to the rescue once again! You'll always be Natlan's hero, {NICKNAME}. Wherever you go, we place our pride and our hope in you!

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Alright, let's save the fawning for later. We don't have much time.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: #The order for the relay will be as follows: First, me. Second, {NICKNAME}. Third, Varesa — and finally, Minnie.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Your section of the course is the first uphill stretch. Remember to pace yourself and conserve your energy. Don't try to sprint the whole way.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Once I hand you the baton, follow the signs until you reach the statue, where you'll hand it off to Varesa.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: We can do this, guys!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Got it.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Alright, time to make a move. Everyone, get to your starting positions.

choices.text: I won't let your trip to Mondstadt be in vain.
"Soulblazers don't give up without a fight."

talks.objective: Head to the start of the track

dialogues.speaker: Slumbering Yigang
dialogues.text: (The feverish patient lies fast asleep. With the competition drawing near, it's best to head to the arena with the others for now.)

talks.objective: Wait for the contest to start

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Contestants, spectators, welcome to the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: My name is Draff, and I'll be serving as referee for today's proceedings by appointment of the organizing committee.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Let me start by saying, I wish all our teams the best of luck, and I look forward to a day of new personal bests, fantastic results — and of course, playing by the rules.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: I'm also obliged to remind everyone how important it is to remain within the bounds of the official race zone. The terrain on Dragonspine is hazardous, and the last thing we want is anyone getting injured, or worse.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: The organizing committee has taken steps to remove all hazards from the race course, but the rest of the mountain remains a danger zone.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Contestants, if you find yourselves unable to complete the race due to injury, illness, or other reasons, please step to the side of the track. A member of the organizing committee will come to your assistance and deliver first aid if necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Captain, where's Yigang? The race is about to start!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I'm afraid Yigang came down with a fever. He's sleeping it off at the moment. Sorry, Minnie, he's not gonna be taking part today.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: What!? But, that means...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME} won't let you down, Minnie! {M#He's}{F#She's} a pro at this stuff. Heck, you might even have a shot at first place!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: ...Okay, got it! Thanks for coming to the rescue!

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: ...And now, it gives me great pleasure to welcome the cross country relay teams:

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: From Sumeru, The Sand Blasters. From Inazuma, Lightning Strike.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: From Liyue, The Sunset Squadron, and from Fontaine, The Frostbite Friends.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Next we have the adventurer contingent, Dragonspine Must Be Scaled. And coming all the way from Springvale, The Mild Hunt.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Last but by no means least, we have a team that brings together contestants from all over Teyvat.... The Soulblazers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like we've got some pretty strong competition.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Don't panic! There's no need to be nervous. Think about Fietena. It's time to show our courage!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Together, there's no obstacle we can't overcome! ...And if there is, just charge right on through!

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: I'm not sure that's an option for everyone else... Uhh, okay, fine, yeah, charge it is. I'm not gonna nitpick your motivational speech.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll show you how it's done.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: I'm gonna give it my all! I believe in our team, and I believe in me!

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Will all contestants please proceed to your starting positions.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Ready... Go!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Whew! Made it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Great, I'll take it from here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Phew! Varesa, I did it.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Thanks! My time to shine!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Minnie! You take it from here. I'll be right behind you!

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Alright, here goes nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Monsters! At least they're not on the course... Better steer clear.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Oh, everyone's waiting for me by the side of the course... I'm coming, guys!

dialogues.speaker: Inazuman Contestant
dialogues.text: ...I can't do it... I'm out of steam. Ugh, I can barely see... Wait, is this the right way?

dialogues.speaker: Inazuman Contestant
dialogues.text: Shoot, I've gone off-course!

dialogues.speaker: Inazuman Contestant
dialogues.text: No no no, stay back...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Oh... Uh oh!

dialogues.speaker: Confused Inazuman Contestant
dialogues.text: ...Help!

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: It's fine... I'll keep going... I gotta get a good ranking.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: I don't wanna drag the team down.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I believe in you, Minnie.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I do too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me help you.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: ...I know I should keep going, but I'm sorry — I can't ignore this.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Quick, over here!

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: #Someone's injured... We have to help them. Varesa! {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: On it!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Minnie, get the injured person to the finish line. We'll handle the rest.

talks.objective: Check with your teammates about the contest results
Return to the camp with your companions

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Well, we weren't the winning team or the runners-up, but one way or another, we still came away with medals!

dialogues.speaker: Tang Yigang
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... *coughing*... I picked the worst time to get sick, didn't I...

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Don't even think about that, Yigang. Just focus on getting better.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: It's a shame we didn't all get to compete together, but at least we got a group photo.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: If anyone has regrets, I say we come back next time and go for gold.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Yigang
dialogues.text: I'll be back... *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Take it easy, Yigang. Next time, you can start by not getting ill.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Captain, I think I'll join you for training next time just in case. That way, I can fill in if someone has to drop out at the last minute.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: It's decided then. The Soulblazers will return for the next cross country challenge!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll be there.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: It's a deal.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Yikes, it's even colder today... Just my luck.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}'s up ahead. Time to pass on the baton.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: My section is uphill all the way. I gotta remember to pace myself.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: No time for a detour. Just gonna jump on down through the gap.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: ...Around the tree, then straight ahead... We're making good time.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Come on, Minnie. You can do this.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: What happened? Someone got injured?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Amber, we got a situation!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Roger that. On it!

dialogues.speaker: Staff Member
dialogues.text: ...Boost your stamina here...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15914
dialogues.text: You can do it!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15915
dialogues.text: Keep going!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15916
dialogues.text: Yeah, speed demon!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15917
dialogues.text: You're killing it!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15918
dialogues.text: Eyes on the road!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15919
dialogues.text: Yeah! You're almost there!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, you've already fallen a long way behind the leaders.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The gap between you and Minnie is too big.
